MapaUiWelcome.headline: The interface color follows the biome's month
MapaUiWelcome.intro: Caativar's maps and analysis module. The interface wears the color of the current month, measured since 1985 by tracking the native vegetation with Landsat satellite imagery and a camera installed in the field. Layers on soil, biomass, productivity, flux, fire and land use are available, and statistics are computed over them by municipality, territory or drawn area.
MapaUiWelcome.cycleNote: {phase}. The height of each bar follows how leafed-out the vegetation is in that month, measured over forty years; the dot marks the current month.
